TikTok is seeking a Fullstack Software Engineer Graduate to join its Global E-Commerce Team. The role focuses on building scalable web applications and product experiences for e-commerce workflows, collaborating across product, design, and engineering, and improving architecture, APIs, and AI-powered features.

Responsibilities
Develop scalable and reusable web applications that support complex E-commerce products and business workflows
Build reliable and user-friendly product experiences with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and maintainability
Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate product requirements into high-quality technical solutions
Design and optimize application architecture, APIs, services, and data flows to improve scalability, reliability, and engineering efficiency
Build or integrate AI-powered product experiences, such as intelligent assistance, personalized modules, or productivity-enhancing workflows
Leverage AI-assisted development workflows to improve code quality, testing, debugging, and development efficiency

Required
Minimum Qualifications:
- Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
- Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, and at least one modern frontend framework such as React, Vue, or Angular.
- Understanding of fundamental software engineering concepts, including data structures, algorithms, asynchronous programming, object-oriented design, testing, and debugging.
- Basic knowledge of backend development and web application architecture, including APIs, databases, client-server communication, and common multi-tier architectures.
- Familiarity with standard software development practices, including version control, testing, and software development workflows
Preferred
Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience building and shipping fullstack applications, with the ability to contribute across multiple layers of the technology stack.
- Experience with backend frameworks, databases, cloud services, APIs, or frontend tooling and build systems.
- Demonstrated engineering judgment and product awareness, with the ability to consider factors such as performance, scalability, reliability, usability, and maintainability when making technical decisions.
- Experience building or integrating AI-powered features, or using LLMs and AI Agents to solve engineering or product problems; ability to evaluate, debug, and iteratively improve AI-generated outputs.
- Demonstrated ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, proactively identify problems, and drive solutions with limited guidance.
- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative, and globally distributed team environment
